metadata.title: Comprehensive Database of Scholarships, Education Schemes & Financial Assistance for Students of Madhya Pradesh
metadata.disclaimer: Data compiled from official government portals, scheme guidelines, and verified educational sources as of June 2026. Verify all details from official portals before applying. Scheme parameters (amounts, dates, eligibility) are subject to annual revision by implementing authorities.

general_ews: MP-STATE-006 (Gaon Ki Beti - no caste restriction)

all_genders: All other schemes open to all genders

notes_and_gaps: Bicycle distribution scheme, uniform scheme, and book assistance - MP government runs these through school education department; exact current scheme details not publicly available in verified official sources as of June 2026. Verify at https://shikshaportal.mp.gov.in.
MP government hostels for SC/ST students - detailed current scheme parameters require verification at https://www.tribal.mp.gov.in and https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in.
National Fellowship programmes (UGC, ICMR, CSIR) are for PhD/research students; MP students eligible but not included in this dataset as they go beyond scholarship to fellowship level.

PM SHRI Schools in MP - central scheme upgrading government schools; students in PM SHRI schools eligible for all applicable scholarships. Current list of PM SHRI schools in MP available at https://pmshrischools.education.gov.in.
Minority Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (Maulana Azad National Fellowship) discontinued in 2022; not included.
Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship for Academic Excellence (studying abroad) - MP students may apply; details at https://highereducation.mp.gov.in.
MP Tribal Welfare Department also operates coaching assistance programs (free coaching for competitive exams like UPSC, MPSC, banking) for ST students - verify at https://tribal.mp.gov.in.
CG Scholarship and NTSE are separate; NTSE 2023 onwards merged/restructured - verify current status at https://ncert.nic.in.
INSPIRE-SHE amount noted as ₹80,000/year in some sources and ₹80,000 in DST official website; confirm current rate at https://online-inspire.gov.in.

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
schemes.implementing_authority: Department of Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.department: Department of Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment

eligible_courses: Any UG degree in Govt/Aided/Private colleges
education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government and Private AICTE/UGC/MCI approved institutions in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Full tuition fee reimbursement (admission fee + actual tuition fee, excluding mess/caution money)
monetary.tuition_coverage_note: 100% tuition fee for Govt colleges; up to Fee Regulatory Committee approved amount for private colleges; max ₹1.5 lakh/year for private colleges
monetary.hostel_coverage_note: Hostel fee included for residential students

demographic.state_requirement: Permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh (Domicile Certificate required)

economic.family_income_limit: Annual family income from all sources must be below ₹6,00,000

social_category.note: All categories eligible if criteria met

academic.minimum_percentage: 70% in Class 12 (MPBSE) OR 85% in Class 12 (CBSE/ICSE). For Engineering: JEE Main rank ≤1,50,000. For Medical: NEET qualified. For Law: CLAT qualified (NLU/DU admission).
academic.rank_requirement: JEE Main ≤1,50,000 for engineering; NEET for medical; CLAT for law
academic.course_restrictions: UG professional/degree courses only; not PG-level fresh applications

application_details.renewal_conditions: Pass each academic year; continue in same institution

benefit_delivery.payment_note: Fees paid directly to institutions (Govt colleges); DBT to student's bank account for private colleges

schemes.notes: Over 1.5 lakh students have benefited; ₹500+ crore disbursed since 2017. 2026 State Budget has reaffirmed dedicated allocation. Application window for 2025-26 tentatively opened late July 2025.

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Jan Kalyan (Shiksha Protsahan) Yojana (MMJKY)
alternate_names: Jan Kalyan Sambal Yojana Education Incentive
schemes.implementing_authority: Department of Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.department: Department of Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government and recognized private institutions in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Full tuition fee for government institutions; up to ₹1.5 lakh/year for private colleges
monetary.tuition_coverage_note: Full fee for govt institutions; up to ₹1,50,000 for private

economic.family_income_limit: Parent/guardian must be a registered unorganized worker under Mukhya Mantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal) Yojana (Sambal Card holder)

social_category.note: All categories eligible; key criterion is Sambal Card (unorganized worker registration)

academic.minimum_percentage: Admission to recognized course through merit/entrance exam
academic.rank_requirement: JEE/NEET/CLAT required for respective professional courses
academic.course_restrictions: UG, Diploma, ITI, and professional courses

benefit_delivery.payment_note: Fees directly to institutions; difference via DBT

schemes.notes: Specifically for children of unorganized workers registered under Jan Kalyan Sambal Yojana (Sambal Card). Parent/guardian must possess valid Sambal Card.

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students (MP)
schemes.implementing_authority: Social Justice and Disability Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.department: Social Justice and Disability Welfare Department

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government and recognized institutions in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: 100% scholarship for family income up to ₹1,00,000; 50% scholarship for family income ₹1,00,000–₹6,00,000. Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, book grant.
monetary.monthly_amount: Maintenance allowance varies by course level (up to ₹1,500/month)

academic.minimum_percentage: Passed Class 10 (matriculation); enrolled in post-matric course

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students (MP / MPTAAS)
alternate_names: Madhya Pradesh Tribal Affairs Automation System
schemes.implementing_authority: Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.department: Tribal Welfare Department (Aadim Jati Kalyan Vibhag)

eligible_courses: All post-matric/post-secondary courses including ITI, Diploma, UG, PG, Professional
education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Recognized schools, colleges, universities, professional institutions in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Maintenance allowance up to ₹1,500/month; book grant; disability allowance (additional). 100% scholarship for income up to ₹5,00,000; 50% for ₹5,00,001–₹6,00,000.

demographic.state_requirement: Permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh (Domicile Certificate required)

academic.minimum_percentage: Passed Class 10; enrolled in recognized post-matric course

application_details.renewal_conditions: Annual Samagra ID verification; Aadhaar e-KYC required (MPTAAS 2.0 from July 2025)

benefit_delivery.payment_note: Upgraded to MPTAAS 2.0 in July 2025 with Aadhaar-based e-KYC and Samagra ID for cross-departmental data validation; DBT payments secured

schemes.notes: MPTAAS upgraded to 2.0 in July 2025. Also covers SC students via the same portal. Not availing any other central/state scholarship simultaneously.

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students (MP)
schemes.implementing_authority: Government of Madhya Pradesh (OBC Welfare)
schemes.department: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department / Social Justice

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Recognized institutions

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: 100% scholarship; covers tuition fee, maintenance allowance, book grant

economic.family_income_limit: Annual family income up to ₹3,00,000 for 100% scholarship

academic.minimum_percentage: Passed Class 10; enrolled in recognized post-matric course

schemes.scheme_name: Gaon Ki Beti Yojana
schemes.implementing_authority: Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government and private recognized colleges in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹5,000/year (₹500/month × 10 months) for regular courses; ₹7,500/year (₹750/month × 10 months) for technical/medical courses

demographic.state_requirement: Permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh (Rural area)
demographic.rural_note: Must reside in rural area (MP Rural Residence Certificate required)

economic.family_income_limit: No specific income limit; all categories eligible

social_category.note: No caste restriction; open to all rural girls

academic.minimum_percentage: Minimum 60% marks in Class 12
academic.course_restrictions: Pursuing graduation (UG) in any recognized college; not for PG

institutional.note: Both government and private recognized colleges eligible

application_details.renewal_conditions: Not renewable; scholarship valid for 10 months in the grant year only

benefit_delivery.payment_note: DBT directly to student's Aadhaar-linked bank account

schemes.notes: Non-renewable; applies only for 1 year. Can be combined with other scholarships.

schemes.scheme_name: Pratibha Kiran Scholarship Yojana
alternate_names: Urban Girls Higher Education Scholarship MP
schemes.implementing_authority: Government of Madhya Pradesh (Higher Education)

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Recognized colleges in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹5,000/year (₹500/month × 10 months)

demographic.state_requirement: Permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh (Urban area)
demographic.urban_note: Must reside in urban area; for urban girls below poverty line

economic.family_income_limit: Annual family income < ₹54,000 for degree courses; < ₹1,20,000 for ITI/Higher Education

social_category.note: No caste restriction; open to all urban BPL girls

academic.minimum_percentage: Minimum 60% marks in Class 12
academic.course_restrictions: Pursuing graduation (UG) in recognized college

schemes.notes: Complementary to Gaon Ki Beti (which is for rural girls); this scheme targets urban BPL girls with same benefit amount.

schemes.scheme_name: Vikramaditya Scholarship Yojana
schemes.implementing_authority: Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government or aided non-government colleges in Madhya Pradesh

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹2,500/year fee exemption (for graduation); covers admission/tuition fee up to ₹2,500 for degree courses
monetary.tuition_coverage_note: Up to ₹2,500 per year towards tuition/admission fee

economic.family_income_limit: Annual family income < ₹54,000 for graduation (degree) courses; < ₹1,20,000 for higher education

social_category.note: Primarily for General category students from economically weaker sections; OBC also eligible

academic.minimum_percentage: Minimum 60% marks in Class 12
academic.course_restrictions: Pursuing UG degree at government/aided non-government college in MP only

institutional.government_college_note: Government OR aided non-government college mandatory

schemes.notes: Targeted at General + OBC students who do not qualify for reserved category scholarships but need financial support.

schemes.scheme_name: Vidhyarthi Awas Bhatta Sahayata Yojana (for SC/ST Students)
schemes.implementing_authority: Government of Madhya Pradesh (Social Justice / Tribal Welfare Departments)

eligible_courses: All post-matric courses for students living away from home for studies

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Housing/accommodation allowance for students studying away from home (not in government hostel)
monetary.hostel_coverage_note: Monthly accommodation/rent allowance for students staying away from home

economic.family_income_limit: Within SC/ST post-matric scholarship income limits

academic.minimum_percentage: Enrolled in recognized post-matric course; not residing in government hostel

schemes.notes: Separate schemes exist for SC (under Social Justice dept) and ST (under Tribal Welfare dept). Exact monthly allowance amount requires verification from official portal.

schemes.scheme_name: Nishaktjan Scholarship Yojana (for Persons with Disabilities)
schemes.implementing_authority: Social Justice and Disability Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.department: Social Justice and Disability Welfare Department (Nishaktjan Vibhag)

eligible_courses: All recognized courses in MP and outside MP (recognized institutions)

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Tuition fee, maintenance allowance, and transport allowance. Exact amounts vary by course level. Cannot be combined with SC/ST/OBC fee exemptions.

economic.family_income_limit: Not specified separately; subject to scheme guidelines

social_category.note: Open to all categories but student cannot simultaneously avail SC/ST/OBC fee exemption and this scheme - must choose one

disability.specific_disability_categories: All disability categories recognized under RPWD Act 2016

academic.minimum_percentage: Enrolled as regular student in recognized institution
academic.attendance_requirement: Regular attendance; if student fails a semester/year, not eligible for repeat semester allowances

institutional.note: Both MP and outside-MP recognized institutions eligible

application_details.application_mode: OFFLINE (submit hard copy to Social Justice Department, Old Secretariat Collectorate, Bhopal)

schemes.notes: Application process is partially offline. Students receiving SC/ST/OBC fee exemptions cannot combine with this scheme. Must choose one.

schemes.scheme_name: Pratibhashali Vidyarthi Protsahan Yojana (Free Laptop Scheme)
schemes.implementing_authority: School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government or MP Board affiliated schools

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹25,000 financial assistance to purchase laptop

social_category.note: All categories eligible; purely merit-based

academic.minimum_percentage: 85% or more aggregate marks in Class 12 MPBSE exam; must pass all subjects
academic.course_restrictions: Class 12 passed from MPBSE board only; not CBSE/ICSE

application_details.application_mode: AUTOMATIC (no separate application; auto-identified from MPBSE results)

benefit_delivery.payment_note: ₹25,000 credited directly to student's Aadhaar-linked bank account after MPBSE result announcement

timeline.application_start: Automatically triggered after MPBSE Class 12 results (typically May)

schemes.notes: In 2025, ₹235 crore distributed to 94,234 students. Benefits auto-disbursed after MPBSE result declaration. Eligibility: 85%+ in MPBSE Class 12 board. No separate application needed.

schemes.scheme_name: MP Model Higher Secondary Schools and Girls Education Complex Scholarship
schemes.implementing_authority: School Education Department / Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government Model Higher Secondary Schools and Girls Education Complexes in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Scholarship/stipend for meritorious girl students at model institutions; exact amount varies

economic.family_income_limit: As per scheme guidelines; typically for economically weaker sections

academic.minimum_percentage: Merit-based selection

schemes.notes: Limited detailed data available publicly. Verify exact amounts and current status at official MP scholarship portal.

schemes.scheme_name: PM YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT Students
alternate_names: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India - Pre Matric
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government/government-aided/local body recognized schools

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹4,000/year consolidated academic allowance (up to ₹75,000 for top-class school scheme)

demographic.state_requirement: Must be resident of Madhya Pradesh (state-capped quota applies)

social_category.note: OBC, EBC (Economically Backward Class), DNT (De-Notified Tribes) only

academic.minimum_percentage: Currently studying in Class 9 or 10

institutional.note: Government or government-aided schools only; not private unaided

documents_required: OTR number (via NSP OTR app with Aadhaar face authentication)

schemes.notes: OTR (One Time Registration) via NSP OTR app with Aadhaar face authentication is mandatory from 2024-25 onwards. Cannot combine with other central govt scholarship for same class.

schemes.scheme_name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT Students
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligible_courses: Post-matric level - Class 11 onwards, including UG, PG, professional, diploma
education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government-recognized institutions

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Academic allowance + other benefits; amount varies by course level; maintenance allowance, compulsory non-refundable fee reimbursement

social_category.note: OBC, EBC, DNT categories

academic.minimum_percentage: Enrolled in post-matric/post-secondary level recognized course

schemes.scheme_name: PM YASASVI Top Class School Education for OBC/EBC/DNT
alternate_names: YASASVI Central Sector Scheme for Schools
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Top-performing schools with 100% pass rate in Class 10 and 12 board exams

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹75,000 for Class 9; ₹1,25,000 for Class 11; covers tuition, hostel fees, other school charges

social_category.note: OBC, EBC, DNT students

institutional.note: School must have 100% pass rate in Class 10 and 12 board exams (top-performing schools)

benefit_delivery.payment_note: ₹75,000/₹1,25,000 via DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank account

schemes.scheme_name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
alternate_names: National Means Cum Merit Scholarship Scheme
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Education (MoE), Government of India
schemes.department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education

eligible_courses: Class 9 to 12 in government/government-aided/local body schools
education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government, government-aided, and local body schools only

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) for Class 9 to 12

demographic.state_requirement: Student must be resident of Madhya Pradesh (state quota applies)

social_category.note: All categories; state-wise quota with category-based reservations

academic.minimum_percentage: Selected via NMMS state examination; must pass each class (60% for Class 10 to continue; 55% for SC/ST to continue). Students must be promoted from Class 8 to Class 9 to begin.
academic.course_restrictions: Government/government-aided schools only; no private school

institutional.note: Only government, government-aided, or local body schools

application_details.application_mode: ONLINE via NSP (after qualifying NMMS exam)
application_details.application_frequency: ANNUAL (exam in Class 8 for Class 9 entry; renewal annually)
application_details.renewal_conditions: Pass each class; maintain 55-60% marks; promoted to next class in first attempt

timeline.application_start: NMMS exam typically held in November–December; application on NSP after passing

schemes.notes: 1 lakh scholarships awarded nationally per year. Strictly for government school students. No application fee.

schemes.scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
alternate_names: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Scheme
schemes.implementing_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Regular degree programs in UGC/AICTE/MCI/statutory body recognized institutions with valid AISHE code

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: UG (first 3 years): ₹12,000/year; PG: ₹20,000/year; 4th year engineering: ₹20,000/year; 4th+5th year professional: ₹20,000/year

demographic.state_requirement: Any state (all India; MP students eligible under state-wise quota)

economic.family_income_limit: Annual family income from all sources < ₹4,50,000

social_category.note: All categories; stream-wise and state-wise quotas apply

academic.minimum_percentage: Above 80th percentile (top 20%) of successful candidates in Class 12 board (Science/Commerce/Humanities stream separately); enrolled in regular UG/PG course
academic.attendance_requirement: 75% attendance; 50% marks each year for renewal
academic.course_restrictions: Regular (not correspondence/distance) UG/PG programs only

institutional.note: Institution must have valid AISHE code; not for diploma/ITI

application_details.renewal_conditions: 50% marks in annual exams; 75% attendance; promoted to next year/semester

schemes.notes: 82,000 scholarships awarded nationally (41,000 each for Science and Commerce+Humanities combined). Stream-wise and state-board-wise merit cutoffs apply.

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities (NSP)
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government and recognized schools

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Admission fee: ₹500/year; Tuition fee: ₹350/month (for Classes 1-10)

social_category.note: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Zoroastrian, Jain communities only (as defined under National Commission for Minorities Act 1992)

academic.minimum_percentage: 50% marks in previous class examination

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities (NSP)
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India

eligible_courses: Class 11 and above, all post-matric courses

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Maintenance allowance, compulsory non-refundable fee reimbursement, and other benefits; amount varies by course level

social_category.note: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Zoroastrian, Jain communities

academic.minimum_percentage: 50% marks in previous qualifying exam

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Central Govt)
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government/government-aided schools

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Maintenance allowance + ad hoc grant; varies by class and residential status (day scholar vs hosteller)

academic.minimum_percentage: Studying in Class 9 or 10

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Central / State)
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Maintenance allowance (varies by level: hosteller/day scholar), compulsory fee reimbursement, book grant. Amounts up to ₹48,000/year for master's level hostellers.

academic.minimum_percentage: Enrolled in recognized post-matric course

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Central Govt)
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government/government-aided schools

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Maintenance allowance + book grant; amount varies by day scholar/hosteller status

academic.minimum_percentage: Studying in Class 9 or 10; enrolled in government school

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Central Govt)
schemes.implementing_authority: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Maintenance allowance, compulsory fee reimbursement, book grant; up to ₹60,000/year for master's level hostellers

schemes.scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
schemes.implementing_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: AICTE-approved institutions

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹50,000/year for every year of study (lump sum towards fees, books, equipment, laptop)

demographic.state_requirement: Any state (all India; MP girl students eligible)

social_category.note: All categories eligible; max 2 girl children per family

academic.minimum_percentage: Admitted to 1st year of AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma course
academic.course_restrictions: Technical degree (4-year) or technical diploma programs only

application_details.application_frequency: ANNUAL (fresh for 1st year; renewal for subsequent years)
application_details.renewal_conditions: Academic performance; continued enrollment in same institution

schemes.notes: 5,000 total scholarships nationally per year. Max 2 girl children per family. For degree: 4-year program scholarship; for diploma: duration of program.

schemes.scheme_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
schemes.implementing_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

eligible_courses: 1st year of Technical Diploma or Degree program (AICTE-approved)
education_coverage.eligible_institutions: AICTE-approved institutions

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹50,000/year for every year of study

disability.specific_disability_categories: All disability categories (benchmark disability under RPWD Act 2016)

academic.minimum_percentage: Admitted to 1st year AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma

schemes.scheme_name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
alternate_names: Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research - SHE
schemes.implementing_authority: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India

education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Any academic institute or university in India offering natural/basic sciences programs

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: ₹80,000/year for B.Sc./M.Sc. level study in natural sciences

social_category.note: All categories; purely merit-based

academic.minimum_percentage: One of: Top 1% in Class 12 board; OR top 10,000 ranks in JEE-Advanced; OR top 10,000 ranks in NEET; OR admitted to IISER/NISER/DAE-CBS; OR KVPY/NTSE/JBNSTS Scholar; OR Science Olympiad Medallist
academic.rank_requirement: Top 1% in Class 12 board OR specific competitive exam criteria
academic.course_restrictions: Natural and Basic Sciences ONLY (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Earth Sciences etc.); NOT engineering, medicine, or professional courses directly

application_details.renewal_conditions: Satisfactory academic performance; continuing in natural sciences program

benefit_delivery.payment_note: Must link SBI bank account with Aadhaar for disbursement

timeline.application_end: Annually; check https://online-inspire.gov.in for batch-specific dates

schemes.notes: 12,000 scholarships nationally per year. Strictly for natural/basic sciences; not for engineering or medical. Mentorship programme included.

schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Central)
schemes.implementing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Tuition fee reimbursement, reader allowance (for visually impaired), escort allowance (for severely disabled), maintenance allowance

disability.specific_disability_categories: All types of disabilities (visual, hearing, locomotor, intellectual etc.)

academic.minimum_percentage: Enrolled in Class 1-10 in recognized school

schemes.scheme_name: Awas Bhatta Sahayata Yojana (Housing Allowance for SC/ST Students)
schemes.implementing_authority: Higher Education Department / Social Justice & Tribal Welfare Departments, Government of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.department: Higher Education Department (for SC/ST students in higher education); also under MPTAAS portal for tribal students

eligible_courses: All post-matric courses pursued away from home
education_coverage.eligible_institutions: Government and recognized institutions in MP

monetary.scholarship_amount_description: Monthly housing allowance: ₹2,000/month for major cities (Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Ujjain); ₹1,000/month for other towns. Paid for actual months of study.
monetary.monthly_amount_note: ₹2,000/month in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Ujjain; ₹1,000/month in other towns
monetary.hostel_coverage_note: Covers private rent/accommodation cost; not for those in government hostels

demographic.state_requirement: Permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh; studying away from home district

economic.family_income_limit: Annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000

social_category.note: Also available to OBC students via MPTAAS portal (SC/ST/OBC under MPTAAS Awas Sahayata)

academic.minimum_percentage: Enrolled as regular student in recognized institution
academic.attendance_requirement: Must not be residing in government hostel; must have private accommodation
academic.course_restrictions: Post-matric level courses only; study city must be different from home district

institutional.note: Principal of nearest government institution acts as approving officer for non-government institution students

application_details.application_mode: ONLINE via MP Scholarship Portal 2.0 / MPTAAS
application_details.renewal_conditions: Annual; submit rent receipt/affidavit; must not be in government hostel
documents_required: Proof of Private Accommodation (Rent Agreement or Affidavit)

benefit_delivery.payment_note: DBT to student's Aadhaar-linked bank account after approval by institution principal

schemes.notes: Also operated through MPTAAS portal as 'MPTAAS Awas Sahayata Yojana' for SC/ST/OBC students receiving MPTAAS post-matric scholarship. Student must submit rental agreement or affidavit confirming private accommodation.

schemes.scheme_name: Nishulk Cycle Praday Yojana (Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme)
